item.title: Oze Marshland National Park: Japan's High-Altitude Wetland — Guide
item.description: Oze Marshland National Park is one of Japan’s great wilderness areas, a vast high-altitude wetland straddling Fukushima, Gunma, Niigata and Tochigi prefectures, protected as a national park since 2007. Wooden boardwalks wind through the marsh, letting hikers explore without disturbing the fragile peat-bog ecosystem, famous each May and June for spectacular blooms of white skunk cabbage (mizubasho) followed by alpine wildflowers through summer, with Mt. Shibutsu rising above the plain.
